facts.text: A Position carries x, y and z in millimetres and r as a rotation angle in degrees
The position controller's axis codes are X=1, Y=2, Z=3 and R=4
move_x moves the X axis to a target position in millimetres
move_y moves the Y axis to a target position in millimetres
move_z moves the Z axis to a target position in millimetres and warns that Z movement needs careful consideration of focus and collision risks
move_rotation moves the rotation axis to an angle in degrees
The axis moves send the command and return immediately; motion completion is tracked asynchronously and the callback fires when motion stops
move_to_position moves all four axes and, when validate is true, clamps an out-of-range target to the configured soft limits instead of raising
get_stage_limits delegates to the configuration service and its per-microscope settings
The configuration service documents that stage limits are loaded from the microscope-specific settings JSON so each microscope can be configured without code changes
get_current_position returns the locally tracked position; the microscope hardware does not report the current position
get_home_position reads the Home x-axis, y-axis, z-axis and r-axis values from ScopeSettings.txt
set_home_position validates the position against the stage limits and writes the four Home values back to ScopeSettings.txt
emergency_stop sends the HALT command (0x6002) to the hardware first, then sets a flag that prevents new movements until it is cleared
The clone README describes control software for Flamingo light sheet microscope systems that communicates with the microscope over TCP/IP
